comments.text:
In my opinion, saying Shadow is Sonic's #1 rival is kinda not true. Let me explain before I get flamed.

Sonic and Shadow, sure they butt heads at each other, but they have repescts for each other and help each other from time to time. So I consider them more so frienemies or just respected allies more than rivals.

Now I say Metal Sonic is Sonic's best rival because not only does Metal Sonic want to throw hands with Sonic at every chance he has, but he also just never respects him nor like him in anyway. 

Metal is trying to prove that he is the REAL Sonic by defeating the real one, and unlike Shadow, Metal doesn't ever want to side with Sonic. But he did in the IDW comics only because Eggman told him to.

So that's why I say Metal Sonic is Sonic's true rival and not Shadow. Metal Sonic and Sonic just hate each other, which fits more as rivals, while Sonic and Shadow have respect for each other while still kinda being friends.
